te: A bird’s eye view spit: a Ukrainian escaped to Moldova on a motorcycle paraglider
de: A resident of Khmelnytsky region crossed the border with Moldova on a motorized paraglider and landed about two kilometers from the state border. The incident was reported by the Moldovan border guards
